notes.title: Version 3.144 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Core system updated to support the latest operating systems
 Fixed minor bugs and other small issues

notes.title: Air - 2236 A.D. Original Soundtrack Update Coming This Friday
notes.notes: As mentioned in the previous update, the soundtrack for 2236 A.D. will be getting updated on at 12:00 PM PST, Friday, September 23, 2022. It is not required to get the update, again we ask that you do not stream or show the previous songs on the internet without Chloro's permission.
